members.name: banking_routing
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. What is the customer's specific request or problem?

criteria.age_limit: minimum age / age requirements to open an account
criteria.apple_google_pay: using or adding Apple Pay / Google Pay
criteria.atm_support: which ATMs accept the card, using ATMs in general
criteria.automatic_top_up: setting up or how auto top-up works
criteria.balance_not_updated_bank_transfer: balance not updated after receiving/making a bank transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated_cheque_cash: cheque or cash deposit not yet showing in balance
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: cannot add a beneficiary / recipient not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made (e.g. sent to wrong account)
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card expiring, renewal or replacement for expiry
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, will it work at a merchant
criteria.card_arrival: ordered card has not arrived, tracking card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, delivery dates/countries
criteria.card_linking: linking or adding an existing card into the app; a card previously reported lost has been found and they want to use or reactivate it
criteria.card_payment_fee: a fee was charged for a card payment
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment the customer did not make or does not recognise (e.g. an unknown charge from a merchant)
criteria.card_payment_wrong_fx: complaint that the wrong exchange rate was applied to a card purchase abroad
criteria.card_swallowed: an ATM kept/swallowed the card, or needing a new card because an ATM took it
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: fee charged for ATM cash withdrawal, withdrawal fees
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: cash withdrawal the customer did not make
criteria.change_pin: changing, setting or finding the card PIN
criteria.compromised_card: card details may be compromised / someone else may have used it
criteria.country_support: which countries the bank supports / customers can live in
criteria.declined_card_payment: card payment declined at a shop or online
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: a direct debit the customer does not recognise, did not set up, or wants refunded
criteria.edit_personal_details: changing name, address or personal details
criteria.exchange_charge: question about what fee is charged for currency exchange
criteria.exchange_overcharged: complaint that a currency exchange cost more than expected or was overcharged
criteria.exchange_rate: what exchange rate is used / rates in general
criteria.exchange_via_app: how to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: an unexplained extra charge or fee on the statement, not tied to a specific kind of transaction (e.g. what is this extra 1 pound?)
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get a disposable virtual card
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get a virtual card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: card is currently lost or stolen, freezing or blocking a card (not a card that has since been found)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: the customer's phone is lost, stolen or left somewhere / not with them, and access to the app without it
criteria.card_cost: how much a card costs or what fees come with getting or holding a card
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot app passcode / cannot log in to the app with passcode
criteria.pending_card_payment: a card payment / purchase is still pending
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: an ATM cash withdrawal is still pending or not yet taken off the balance
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or not accepted, unblocking the PIN
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money, payments or salary into the account, including in another currency
criteria.request_refund: wants a refund for a purchase
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: which card brands (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) or currencies can be used / are accepted for topping up or paying
criteria.top_up_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_cash_cheque: topping up with cash or cheque
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up by card
criteria.transfer_not_received: transfer not received by the recipient
criteria.verify_identity: how to verify identity, documents needed
criteria.verify_top_up: top-up verification: verification code for a top-up, why or how to verify the card used to top up
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: whether they get Visa or Mastercard
criteria.wrong_amount_cash: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash, or the customer has not received the cash they withdrew
criteria.wrong_fx_cash_withdrawal: complaint about a wrong exchange rate on a cash withdrawal abroad
